blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 19-year-old person with disability (PWD) died after he was trapped inside a burning house in Purok Atis, Sitio Kamunggay, Barangay Pitalo, San Fernando town in southern Cebu on Monday morning, November 9. According to his mother, the victim had health issues, and he was left alone at the house for a few minutes.
